name: manual_519cff
claim: When a function's return tuple grows (e.g. insert_event 2-tuple to 3-tuple to 4-tuple), grep the entire codebase for all call sites that unpack the return value before changing the signature. A single missed caller that unpacks the old signature breaks CI silently. Cost of one missed caller exceeds cost of auditing all of them.

decisions.notes: Discovered in PR #211: insert_event return signature changed from 3-tuple to 4-tuple and missed callers broke CI. Before changing any return signature, run grep -rn insert_event --include=*.py and audit every unpack site.

rationale: Discovered in PR #211: insert_event return signature changed from 3-tuple to 4-tuple and missed callers broke CI. Before changing any return signature, run grep -rn insert_event --include=*.py and audit every unpack site.
